notablePrerequisites: There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Fanatical Devotion by sacrificing Karmic Guide, regenerating target creature.
Activate Fanatical Devotion by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fanatical Devotion ability from step 2, regenerating target creature.
Repeat.
